name: theHarvester company domain
description: Lists hosts and addresses for a company domain from six keyless infrastructure sources with theHarvester. Email and people results are discarded.
externalRestrictions: Company domain only. theHarvester's licence was not confirmed from its repository; it is treated as GPL and run only as a separate program. Anything about individuals (email addresses, usernames, people, social profiles) is discarded by design; the tool is run with a fixed allowlist, so those modules cannot be selected. It is a separate program, not part of Mayfair: Ghost downloads it into its tools folder on first use (checksum verified, then tested) or you point Ghost at your own copy. It is shown as installed only after its own self-test passes.
